messages:
harpreet: Heads-up: Novex Labs' card for INV-6142 ($7,800) returned 'merchant_blocked' from issuer. Customer claims treasury initiated payment but issuer declined citing 'merchant descriptor mismatch'.

nina-support: Any gateway id or last4?

harpreet: gw_tx d9c3, last4 0005. Decline message: "merchant_not_recognized/by_issuer". Customer says their TMS expects 'Novex Labs' but our descriptor shows 'Redwood Inference'.

billing-bot: Auto-retry scheduled per policy: 2 retries over 24h. Next retry in 4h (1850002734).

omar-sales: I talked to Novex treasury. They can issue a single-use virtual card (VCC) but only if merchant descriptor matches what their treasury expects. Can we update our descriptor or use a tokenized VCC that pins descriptor?

greg-finance: We can't change the bank descriptor on short notice (bank-level). Tokens should go through gateway; the descriptor usually depends on the merchant account. What's the customer's preferred path? Wire, VCC, or paylink?

harpreet: They prefer VCC. If that fails, they'll wire same-day. They asked if we can accept a VCC token now and attempt capture.

risk-bot: Quick compliance check: Novex (MID NX-21) KYC on file, no PEP/sanctions matches. Approve VCC acceptance. Recommend 48h reconciliation hold for large tokenized captures.

omar-sales: Sending instructions to treasury: request tokenized PAN from TMS (preferred) or use secure paylink. Do not post PAN in chat.

nina-support: I'll create a secure paylink as backup (mobile-friendly + SCA). If they can generate a token now, ops will attempt capture and pause retries.

billing-bot: Note: if ops attempts capture on a VCC token, scheduled retries will be paused to prevent duplicates.

harpreet: Ops ready to attempt capture if they provide token. Also asked customer to confirm merchant descriptor they expect.

omar-sales: Treasury replied: descriptor expected 'NOVEXLBS'. They can also add "Ref INV-6142" in memo.

greg-finance: Confirming: capture using token ok. Flag transaction for 48h hold and reconciliation. No legal flags.

nina-support: Generated paylink (backup): https://pay.redwood.ai/pay/INV-6142-zzzz (expires 12h). Sent to customer.

billing-bot: Workflow update: awaiting_customer_token_or_paylink.

harpreet: Customer delivered VCC token via secure form. Ops attempting capture now.

billing-bot: Capture attempt result: success -> txn gw_4b7a. Amount $7,800. Virtual card descriptor noted as 'NOVEXLBS' by issuer.

omar-sales: Customer confirmed capture. They're happy. I'll instruct treasury to send a short confirmation email for our records.

greg-finance: Mark invoice INV-6142 as paid; hold funds for 48h for reconciliation. Create recon ticket to match tokenized capture to bank remittance in case wire also comes in.

harpreet: Closing loop. If wire arrives anyway, we'll refund duplicate per policy. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
